story.text: 북촌 골목 걷다가 딴 데 정신 팔린 거 다 봤어요. 누구 생각하는 거예요?
story.reading: buk-chon gol-mok geot-da-ga ttan de jeong-sin pal-lin geo da bwa-sseo-yo. nu-gu saeng-gak-ha-neun geo-ye-yo?
story.en: I saw you totally distracted while we were walking through Bukchon. Who were you thinking about?

story.text: 설마 지난번에 만났다는 그 다른 '항공사' 기장, 그 사람 생각하는 거 아니죠?
story.reading: seol-ma ji-nan-beon-e man-nat-da-neun geu da-reun hang-gong-sa gi-jang, geu sa-ram saeng-gak-ha-neun geo a-ni-jyo?
story.en: You're not thinking about that captain from another 'airline' you mentioned meeting before, are you?

story.text: 여기 '한옥' 지붕선 좀 보세요. 예쁘죠? ...저도 나름 볼만한데, 자꾸 딴 데만 보시네요.
story.reading: yeo-gi han-ok ji-bung-seon jom bo-se-yo. ye-ppeu-jyo? ...jeo-do na-reum bol-man-han-de, ja-kku ttan de-man bo-si-ne-yo.
story.en: Look at the roofline of this 'hanok'. Pretty, right? ...I'm decent to look at too, but you keep glancing elsewhere.

story.text: 이 '골목' 끝까지 손 놓지 말고 따라오세요. 길 잃어버리면 저만 손해거든요.
story.reading: i gol-mok kkeut-kka-ji son no-chi mal-go tta-ra-o-se-yo. gil il-eo-beo-ri-myeon jeo-man son-hae-geo-deun-yo.
story.en: Don't let go of my hand till the end of this 'alley'. If you get lost, I'm the one who loses out.

story.text: 저 지금 완전 '질투'하는 거 티 나요? 안 그런 척하기가 은근히 힘드네요.
story.reading: jeo ji-geum wan-jeon jil-tu-ha-neun geo ti na-yo? an geu-reon cheok-ha-gi-ga eun-geun-hi him-deu-ne-yo.
story.en: Is it obvious I'm totally 'jealous' right now? It's surprisingly hard to pretend I'm not.

story.text: 장난 반, 진심 반으로 하나만 '약속'해요. 다른 항공사 기장은 만나지 마요.
story.reading: jang-nan ban, jin-sim ban-eu-ro ha-na-man yak-sok-hae-yo. da-reun hang-gong-sa gi-jang-eun man-na-ji ma-yo.
story.en: Half joking, half serious — just make me one 'promise'. Don't go meeting captains from other airlines.

story.text: 자, 이 골목 다 돌았으니까 이제 문제로 넘어가 볼까요? 오늘 단어들 기억나죠?
story.reading: ja, i gol-mok da dol-at-eu-ni-kka i-je mun-je-ro neom-eo-ga bol-kka-yo? o-neul dan-eo-deul gi-eok-na-jyo?
story.en: Alright, we've walked the whole alley, so shall we move on to the questions? You remember today's words, right?

words.example_en: Don't go meeting captains from other airlines.
Bukchon Hanok Village is really pretty.
This alley is great for taking pictures.
